title: Sewage Discharge Urgent
categories: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report sewage discharging into the street, alley, ditch, creek/creek channel, lake, river or storm drain/inlet. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.
instructions: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report sewage discharging into the street, alley, ditch, creek/creek channel, lake, river or storm drain/inlet. Please call 311 for more information.

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about sewage discharging into a street or waterway.
actions.why: For sewage discharging into a street, alley, ditch, creek or creek channel, lake, river, or storm drain or inlet. The request must be dispatched and its description directs people to call 311.
